title: Valid Palindrome

tests.label: the same letter in both cases
a digit and a letter 32 apart in ASCII
two symbols in a row on one side
every symbol, no letters or digits

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(1250)
alnum = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
half = [r.choice(alnum) for _ in range(60000)]
out = []
for c in half + half[::-1]:
    if r.random() < 0.3:
        out.append(r.choice(" ,.!?;:'-"))
    out.append(c.swapcase() if r.random() < 0.5 else c)
args = [''.join(out)]
tests.label: large: a palindrome of about 156,000 characters
